name: Elizabeth Phebe Deane (Clary, Hamilton)
milestones: Married Francis L. Hamilton (m. 6 Sep 1829, Darke County, OH)
sources: Hamilton family register (The Family of Francis Hamilton and Susan), in Bill Allen’s Further Research (February 2012)
notes: First married Isaac Clary (13 May 1824, Darke County), with two children, Patience and Eliza Ann Clary; a court case of 1830 names her first husband as Vachel Clary. A widow in Greenville in 1880.
